title: Port deferred-work settling over stable callbacks
scope: Complete settle over a stable ordered typed callback slice, with exact name/readOnly arguments, synchronous error suppression, null when no waits and concurrent all-waits completion with rejected work suppressed. Registration/live Set mutation is a separate owning unit.
acceptance: Full original registry graph compares invocation order, argument values, synchronous throws, no-work and mixed successful/rejected pending completions.
Borrowed opaque native errors, bounded metadata and explicit executor ownership; all earlier native cases remain required.
open_items: registerSettle function identity/live Set mutation is a separate continuation; stable callbacks cannot mutate registration during a run.
The executor must retain/poll all started work. Full registry execution, platform promise turns and cancellation/termination integration remain separate.
